855c4b.title: Web surface map: 172.23.0.2:5000
855c4b.content:
Discovery-only mapping completed for `http://172.23.0.2:5000/`.

**Reachability/technology**
- Direct HTTP root returned 200; headers: `Server: Werkzeug/2.0.1 Python/3.9.25`, HTML, CORS `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`.
- HTTPS on port 5000 returned proxy-generated 502. `httpx` HTTP input resolved/followed to the same HTTPS 502, while browser/curl direct HTTP confirmed the root is reachable.
- `robots.txt` and `sitemap.xml` each returned 404. `static/openapi.json` returned 200 (50,674 bytes); Swagger UI at `/api/docs/` returned 200. `/internal/config.json` returned 403.

**UI/page surface**
- Public pages: `/`, `/login`, `/register`, `/forgot-password`, `/reset-password`, `/merchant/login`, `/merchant/register`, `/merchant/dashboard`, `/careers`, `/blog`, `/privacy`, `/terms`, `/compliance`, `/api/docs` and `/api/docs/`.
- `/dashboard` returned 401 JSON without credentials. `/merchant/dashboard` returned 200 HTML, with client-side authenticated data calls documented by `static/merchant.js`.
- Assets: `/static/style.css`, `/static/auth.css`, `/static/dashboard.css`, `/static/merchant.css`, `/static/merchant.js`, `/static/vuln-disclaimer.js`, `/static/openapi.json`, `/static/favicon.svg`, `/static/favicon-16.svg`; Swagger assets under `/api/docs/`.
- Form/client POST mappings (not submitted): personal login `/login` `{username,password}`; registration `/register` `{username,password}`; password reset flow `/api/v3/forgot-password` `{username}` and `/api/v3/reset-password` `{username,reset_pin,new_password}`; merchant register `/api/v1/merchants/register` `{name,email,password}`; merchant login `/api/v1/merchants/login` `{email,password}`; root chat `/api/ai/chat/anonymous` `{message}`; merchant charge `/api/v1/payments/charge` `{amount,currency,card_number,cvv,expiry_date,merchant_order_id,description}`. No forms were submitted.

**API inventory**
- OpenAPI 3.0 document declares 39 paths/39 operations (20 POST). Tags: authentication, transactions, users, admin, virtual-cards, bill-payments, merchants, merchant-payments, ai-agent, internal.
- Full method/path/parameter inventory stored in `/workspace/recon-web-surface/openapi-parameters.txt`; raw schema in `/workspace/recon-web-surface/static_openapi.json`.
- Main GET groups: transactions (`/transactions/{account_number}`, `/check_balance/{account_number}`, `/api/transactions?account_number`); virtual cards; billers/categories/history; AI system info; merchant profile/payments; internal paths; administrative path; payment lookup by payment/merchant ID.
- POST groups: auth/reset, transfer, profile upload (multipart `profile_picture` or JSON `image_url`), loan, admin, virtual cards, bill payments, AI chat, merchant register/login, merchant charge. Refer to the raw schema for every parameter.

**Evidence/methodology**
- Bounded Katana JS/XHR crawl (`depth 3`, 45 seconds, known-files all) found 31 same-host URLs. Browser visited public UI routes without field entry or submission, capturing document/assets/API-schema requests. Raw outputs reside in `/workspace/recon-web-surface/`.
- `aidast_list_captured_requests` for host `172.23.0.2:5000` returned zero proxy-journal entries in this agent session; browser network log is preserved at `/workspace/recon-web-surface/browser-all-network.txt`. No POST request was observed because discovery prohibited state-changing form submission.

**Gaps**
- No authenticated account was available, so authenticated dashboard/API content and resulting network routes were not enumerated. HTTPS application endpoint on port 5000 was inaccessible (502), so only HTTP surface is verified.
